Hi Laura,

Thanks for the demo last week. As part of our SIG intake for production readiness, Acme's security team needs a focused package around encryption and key management. Can you provide the following artifacts for our reviewers?

- High-level description of where keys are generated and stored (KMS/HSM vendor + region).
- Confirmation of at-rest and in-transit encryption controls and algorithms used for customer data.
- Key rotation policy and an export of rotation events for the last 12 months (or most recent quarter if full 12 months not available).
- Evidence of separation of duties (key custodians, role lists) and access control to KMS/HSM.
- BYOK/import and key escrow procedures (if available).
- Any SOC 2 / SIG mapping you already have for key-management controls.

I've attached Acme_SIG_Questions_Q3.xlsx with the specific control IDs we're focusing on. Can you confirm timeline for delivery (we're targeting initial review by 2026-07-15)?

Best,

Quick answers up front:
- Keys are managed in a combination of cloud KMS (primary) and FIPS-140-2/3 HSM clusters for root/wrapping keys.
- In-transit is TLS1.3; at-rest uses AES-256-GCM for customer data stores and envelope encryption for model artifacts.

I'll assemble a package that includes the inventory, rotation logs, policy excerpts, and the HSM cluster inventory. Monica, can you pull the rotation export and the key inventory CSV? Rishi, can you prepare a short mapping file that ties our controls back to common SIG/SOC2 IDs (we can keep it high level)?

> Monica, can you pull the rotation export and the key inventory CSV?

Got it — I'll export the rotation events and the current key inventory by EOD tomorrow. Preliminary notes:
- Rotation: we maintain automated rotation for customer DEKs at 90 days by default; root/wrapping keys are rotated on a 12-month cadence and require approval tickets.
- HSMs: we use managed HSM clusters across two cloud regions (us-west-2 and us-east-1) for wrapping keys; clusters are FIPS-140-2 level (vendor: managed cloud HSM).
- Access: Key admin access is limited via RBAC in our IAM with just-in-time privileges and logged through our audit pipeline.

Attachments I'll include for the package: rw_rotation_log_q2_2026.csv, rw_kms_key_inventory_20260708.csv, hsm_cluster_inventory_20260708.pdf, kms-policy-summary.txt

Subject: Redwood - Key management evidence package for Acme (initial delivery)

Josh — attaching the initial package for your review. See a summary below and the attached files. If you need more granular logs we can discuss an access-controlled transfer.

Package summary:
- rw_kms_key_inventory_20260708.csv — exported list of active KMS keys, key IDs, creation timestamps, key type (customer vs platform), region.
- rw_rotation_log_q2_2026.csv — rotation events for the most recent quarter (deks rotated, wrapping key rotations).
- hsm_cluster_inventory_20260708.pdf — HSM cluster IDs, cloud regions, FIPS status, and operator contact list (redacted).
- kms-policy-summary.txt — excerpt of our KMS policies covering key creation, rotation schedule, role separation, and BYOK import steps.
- Control mapping (in-body) — Rishi included a short mapping tying our controls to SIG v2026 and common SOC 2 CC criteria.

Key points to call out:
- Encryption algorithms: AES-256-GCM for storage envelopes, RSA-3072 or ECC P-384 for wrapping where applicable.
- In-transit: TLS 1.3 everywhere; mTLS between internal services for key access hops.
- Rotation: DEKs auto-rotate default 90d; platform root/wrapping keys 12m with ticketed approval. Emergency rotation: we have an incident runbook (audit ticket + forced rotation + notify affected customers).
- BYOK: we support key import and customer key binding in dedicated capacity and Private deployments; import keys are wrapped on import and stored per customer isolation.

Links and notes:
- Internal evidence folder (read-only link for reviewers): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-kms-evidence
- If Acme wants the SOC 2 control mapping spreadsheet I can export a redacted copy; full SOC 2 reports require an NDAs and SOC access request.

Please confirm receipt and whether we should provide raw audit streams for a deeper review.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
